evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries urgent, high-arousal insistence to purge — a directive performed with forceful negative valence.
Imperative 'Remove' with absolutizing 'all' performs an urgent, high-arousal purge directive — negative valence, activated delivery.
Flat declarative erasure — low-arousal, negative-valence resignation settling the matter as settled fact rather than urgent directive.
